taxi.name: An address. A wet street.
taxi.description: The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.
taxi.sound: The meter clicks. Rain needles the roof.
taxi.smell: Warm vinyl and the driver's mint tea.

street.name: Velvet / side entrance
street.description: Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.
street.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
street.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

vestibule.name: The vestibule
vestibule.description: Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.
vestibule.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
vestibule.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

bar.name: Velvet / the bar
bar.description: A folded towel protects the counter. Two pencils wait beside mismatched cups. The main floor opens toward a small stage; stairs rise beside a quieter salon. A service door leads to the kitchen.
bar.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
bar.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

cloakroom.name: The cloakroom
cloakroom.description: An open rack holds a black jacket. A bench makes a small island beneath the dripping coats.
cloakroom.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
cloakroom.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

washroom.name: The working toilets
washroom.description: The mirror has a clean stripe at eye level. Someone has crossed out a number on the poster and written ASK FIRST.
washroom.sound: Water rattles in the pipes. Voices carry from behind the partition.
washroom.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

kitchen.name: A chair beside the repairs
kitchen.description: A door-closer casing lies open beside cooling chips. The spare chair is clear. Through the hatch you can see the bar.
kitchen.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
kitchen.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

stage.name: The small stage
stage.description: A cable snakes past a keyboard. Someone has taped UNKNOWN to a ring of spare keys. Headphones rest beside a dead phone.
stage.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
stage.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

salon.name: The room beside the floor
salon.description: A circle of chairs leaves plenty of room near the door. Nobody has to cross the threshold to see the room.
salon.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
salon.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

landing.name: Above the bass
landing.description: The stairs end at a narrow landing. Light sits under an office door. The exchange room is farther along the corridor.
landing.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
landing.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

office.name: The office
office.description: A desk faces the window. There are two drawers and a chair that never quite fits beneath it. The door opens onto the landing.
office.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
office.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

exchange-room.name: The exchange room
exchange-room.description: Four chairs. One is the wrong height. A document box waits beneath a water stain. The landing remains open behind you.
exchange-room.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
exchange-room.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

archive.name: The service table
archive.description: A lamp illuminates a clear patch of table. After the transfer, the service envelope and ledger will be left here for the outside witness.
archive.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
archive.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

loading-bay.name: The loading bay
loading-bay.description: Wheel marks cross the loading door. A bus stop faces the service road. A camera watches the trolley ramp with bureaucratic patience.
loading-bay.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
loading-bay.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

kiosk.name: The soup kiosk
kiosk.description: Steam fogs the glass. A handwritten menu promises soup with no further qualifications.
kiosk.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
kiosk.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

apartment.name: Your apartment
apartment.description: The refrigerator hums in two keys at once. Your mug is in the sink. The kettle waits beside an unclaimed patch of counter.
apartment.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
apartment.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.

motel.name: Motel 27
motel.description: The corridor is lit by an exit sign and a vending machine. Room 06 has an ordinary lock. That feels deliberate.
motel.sound: Bass travels through the walls. Somewhere, a glass meets a counter.
motel.smell: Wet wool, old wood, a little lemon cleaner.
